criteria._source: Section 5.1.1 (Search, Success criteria), decided by the author 2026-10-15: the operator judges at the moment of rest whether the torso, projected on the floor, is within max_distance_m of the ball's surface; the ball need not be visible. A run starts only with the battery at 50 % or more; the robot may stay on its charger, and moving the charger cable is not an intervention.
criteria.distance: from the robot's torso, projected on the floor, to the ball's surface
criteria._decided_2026_10_15: author: the visibility condition is dropped; success is the operator's judgement that the torso, projected on the floor, is within max_distance_m of the ball's surface at rest (proximity only, as ObjectNav's oracle-visibility variant). Charging during runs is allowed (weak battery).
criteria._decided_2026_10_19: author, during the main runs (search-A5-20261019T100956Z kicked the ball about 1 m while walking past it): a ball the robot moves is judged where it lies at rest, like any other run; the operator notes the move in the verdict. A clarification of the criterion as written, not a change.
criteria._decided_2026_10_19_falls: author, during the main runs (search-A7-20261019T103145Z: NAOqi reported a fall the operator did not see; its fall manager crouched the robot and NAOqi was unreachable about 30 s, then the agent stood up and succeeded): in Search a fall counts only if the operator saw it (pilot/search.py falls; NAOqi's events are kept as falls_reported_by_naoqi), and such a run stays valid, since a run is invalid only when it fails for a reason outside the agent.
criteria._decided_2026_10_20: author, during the main runs (search-A5-20261020T135013Z, position 39: the robot approached the ball, overshot and kicked it, lost it, and rested 0.40 m from it with the ball behind it to the right, not facing it and not in view): the run is a failure because the robot did not find the ball in the end (verdict author_ruling_failure; pilot/metrics.py). A deviation from the criterion fixed before the main runs (proximity only), reported in the thesis; earlier runs within 1.0 m were not re-judged. Superseded the same day by _decided_2026_10_20_facing: this run fails on facing like any other.
criteria._decided_2026_10_20_facing: author, after the last main run (a deviation from the criterion fixed before the main runs, reported in the thesis): success also requires that the robot faces the ball at rest, as the prompt asks: the ball is in front of the robot, within the bottom camera's horizontal field of view, or under the camera when the robot stops very close (require_facing_ball; the verdict's facing_ball). Where the operator did not note facing, it was judged afterwards from the image of rest's tool result (facing_from_rest_image). Visibility stays dropped.
criteria._decided_2026_10_21_blocks: author, after the 40 main runs (5 per agent, done in two days, with time left): Search goes to 10 runs per agent; the main order is extended with blocks 6-10, drawn with a new seed (pilot/order.py extend; positions 1-40 and their runs are kept). A deviation from the run count fixed before the main runs, decided after their results were known; reported in the thesis. The added runs are judged with the criterion as it stands (require_facing_ball).
criteria._decided_2026_10_21_battery: author, during the main runs (search-A5-20261021T100504Z, position 42: the agent saw the ball after about 4 min, walked past it into a notch by a panel, got out and was heading around the panel when the battery fell from 100 % to 36 % in about 2.5 min with the charging flag flickering, as at position 39, and the robot died during a go): the run is a failure, not invalid, because the robot should have reached the ball before the battery died; the operator ended it as an intervention. Unlike position 39 attempt 1 (search-A5-20261020T133608Z, invalid as a hardware fault, where the agent rested because of the battery). A deviation from the rule that a run failing for a reason outside the agent is invalid; reported in the thesis.
